why: SC 2.5.8 is one of the two criteria WCAG 2.2 added, and axe ships its target-size rule DISABLED, so a default audit never mentions it. This fixture enables the rule explicitly via axeOptions, which is the only way to test a criterion most tooling silently skips. The after is exactly 24x24 - the boundary - so the fixture also pins the threshold rather than approximating it.
